records.text: Owens said Turning Point Faith held a pastor summit led by Rob McCoy and Sean Feucht.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: They had a pastor summit led by Rob McCoy, as I showed you that, Sean Feucht. They were going to lead this up.

verification.notes: TPUSA's own recap confirms that TPUSA Faith hosted a Pastors Summit and lists Rob McCoy among its featured speakers. Independent event coverage identifies both Rob McCoy and Sean Feucht among speakers at a TPUSA Faith Pastors Summit. The available event materials establish their participation but do not establish that McCoy and Feucht jointly led the summit, so the leadership wording is overstated.
